messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High error rate on embeddings-usw2 - paging oncall 
incident-bot: Symptoms: 500 errors and timeouts for /v1/embeddings, spike started ~08:12 UTC, ~40% of requests failing.
oncall-rose: ack. looking now. assigning priority P1. 
oncall-rose: @alex choi can you grab logs for the last 15m from the inference gateway? start with `svc-embeddings-usw2`
alex choi: grabbing logs — running: ```
kubectl logs -l app=embeddings-gateway -n prod --since=15m | grep "error" | tail -n 200
```
alex choi: seeing repeated EOF and model shard load timeouts, and a couple of OOM-kill events on node g2-12-x-3.
sre-jordan: can we route traffic to fallback model or lower-concurrency pool? if so we should reduce blast radius while we investigate.
oncall-rose: triggering fallback routing to quantized-embed-v2 (limited capacity). doing gradual 20% -> 50% -> 100% with canary window.
oncall-rose: /reroute embeddings-usw2 -> quantized-embed-v2 canary=20% ttl=15m  (bot confirms)
incident-bot: Action queued: route change applied (20%). monitor latency and error-rate for next 5m.
maria gonzalez: CS heads up — we have customers in US-W2 seeing failures. pulling list from heartbeat logs now.
cs-lead: drafting customer-facing note. first pass: "We're aware of intermittent failures for embeddings in US-West-2. We're routing traffic to a fallback model which should restore service for most requests; we're continuing to investigate the root cause and will share updates every 30 minutes." thoughts?
sara: add a line about impact: "Some requests may see slightly different embedding vectors; this may affect similarity ranking."
cs-lead: good call. new draft: "We're aware of intermittent failures affecting embeddings in US-West-2. Traffic is being routed to a fallback quantized model; most requests should succeed, but you may notice slight differences in embedding outputs that could change similarity/rerank results. Expected recovery: within 60 minutes. We'll update every 30 minutes."
alex choi: mitigation checklist for support agents (suggested macro):
```
- Acknowledge: We're investigating and routing to fallback.
- Impact: Embeddings in us-west-2 may return errors or slightly different vectors.
- ETA: ~60 minutes; updates every 30 min.
- Troubleshooting steps for agents:
  1) Confirm customer region (us-west-2) and whether they are using custom routing.
  2) Ask for recent request_id examples/log snippets.
  3) If urgent, advise switching to alternative region (us-east-1) or using hosted fallback flag.
  4) If customer sees degraded ranking, suggest re-running key queries after we confirm recovery.
- Macro to paste into Zendesk/Intercom below.
```
zendesk-bot: suggested zendesk macro template loaded: `EMBED-USW2-FAIL-1`
zendesk-bot: Macro preview:
"Thanks for reporting this — we’re aware of intermittent failures affecting embeddings in US-West-2. We’ve routed traffic to a fallback model which should restore most requests; however, outputs may differ slightly and affect similarity results. We expect full recovery within ~60 minutes and will follow up when the issue is resolved. If you need an immediate workaround, you can switch to us-east-1 or enable the hosted-fallback flag. Please share a recent request_id if you can (e.g. `req_01F...`)."
cs-lead: approve with small edit — add contact escalation line: "If this is blocking production, reply and we'll escalate for a hotfix rollout."
incident-bot: Monitoring: error-rate dropped from 42% -> 18% after 20% canary routing. latency increased ~12ms.
alex choi: still seeing two nodes with repeated OOMs. moving suspected bad node out of pool. cordon+drain g2-12-x-3.
alex choi: command: ```kubectl cordon g2-12-x-3 && kubectl drain g2-12-x-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data```
sre-jordan: noted. after drain, autoscaler spun up replacement node; restarting model workers on new node now.
incident-bot: Error-rate stabilized at ~5% after canary increased to 80% and node drain. continuing to monitor.
oncall-rose: plan for handoff at +45m: if error-rate < 10% and no new OOMs, handoff to day SRE with remediation notes. otherwise continue escalation to infra oncall.
cs-lead: status-page blurb (for engineering to post):
"We are investigating elevated error rates for the embeddings endpoint in the US-West-2 region. Traffic has been partially routed to a fallback model to reduce impact; some customers may experience differing embedding outputs. We're working on replacing affected nodes and expect recovery within 60 minutes. Next update in 30 minutes."
alex choi: note for the handoff ticket: include timestamps, node IDs (g2-12-x-3), logs snippets (attach), canary percentages, and zendesk macro id EMBED-USW2-FAIL-1.
sara: creating a support queue tag `incident/embeddings-usw2` and assigning first-line agents to monitor Zendesk for macro replies.
sre-jordan: evidence collection: saving heapdumps and core logs to s3://redwood-incident-archives/1976543210/ for postmortem.
oncall-rose: all good. we'll reconvene at +30. @cs-lead please push macro to active macros and notify CS rotation.
cs-lead: pushed macro, notified rotation, and posted to customer-status slack channel. cc: @product-ops
incident-bot: Next check in scheduled: +30m (1976545010).
cs-lead: quick note for agents using the macro: personalize with region and possible workaround steps, and add the escalation line if customer says "blocking".
alex choi: prepping follow-up runbook item: consider memory tuning for model shard allocation and stricter OOM policies to avoid noisy neighbor effects.
(oncall-rose adds reaction) :thumbsup:
